config.threshold: class-1 probability > 0.5; frozen weights and preprocessing
config.overlap: Compare evaluation to documented train and validation splits, separately: exact text, comment/whitespace-insensitive token identity, identifier-normalized structural candidates. These are bounded near-duplicate screens, not proof of absence of semantic clones.
config.matched: Common-support cells of source language x source-line bins (1-10,11-25,26-50,51-100,101+) x binary label. Cell mass is minimum count across datasets; row weight = cell mass / dataset cell count. Compare full and model-specific intact cohorts; do not pool incompatible label evidence or invent missing CWE/context.
config.inference: Batch 16; seed 42; eval/inference mode; LineVul 512 / VulBERTa 1024 tokens; safetensors for VulBERTa; verify historical parity before control inference.
config.uncertainty: 2000 connected-component cluster bootstrap draws; code/token duplicates, source commits, CVEs and supplied task families stay together. Project sensitivity; same row weights for paired model differences. Matching weights fixed from observed cohorts; intervals conditional on matching.
limitations: Published training procedure is not an attestation of the converted checkpoint history
Authorship is not randomized; no causal authorship conclusion

project.caveat: Descriptive sensitivity only: fewer than 20 independent clusters.
